signals.text: 1 new PM role posted this week

bullets: Conduct product discovery by identifying patient, clinician, and care team pain points through research, data, and operational feedback
Translate ambiguous problems into clear product requirements, workflows, and success metrics
Partner with engineering, design, clinical, and operational teams to prototype, launch, and iterate on AI-powered product experiences, building mock prototypes
Roll up your sleeves to drive impact wherever needed – from shadowing patient calls and training care teams to prototyping solutions and shipping code
